The mods I maintain, plus one cart. My existing Gen1AutoSave listing keeps its
version -- the release job owns that -- and gains the metadata the rest of
these carry.

Derived work is credited in each mod's own CREDITS.md and travels with the
assets: Gen1Follower is built from Antigravity & gamecorner33's PokePC
Followers; Gen1ModernBag derives from FAFF0x's Modern Bag at upstream 1.6.0,
MIT notice carried verbatim; the item icons in Gen1ModernBag and Gen1WildUI are
Polished Crystal's, by Rangi42 and that project's graphics contributors;
Gen1Arena's backdrops are the Battle Backgrounds Patch FR. Nothing distributed
is ROM-derived.

Wild Green pins four published builds and republishes none of them.
